rule.message:
All degree-seeking students must complete the University's Liberal Education requirements .
At least half of the upper division credits required for the major must be taken at University of Minnesota Twin Cities. (36 crs) Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
There are no required courses for admission, only a 30-credit requirement. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
